chunks: And in it, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He made for them partners in it to mislead them in knowledge. And for them is no knowledge of it; they follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the Shia doctrine of *al-ghulub* (dominance) of Satan, clarifying that his power is not intrinsic but contingent upon human free will and adherence to his whispers. This narration underscores that Satan's 'partners' are the internal desires and false assumptions of the believer, linking the external temptation to internal spiritual state. It serves as a theological foundation for understanding how believers can maintain immunity from Satan's influence through conscious choice and knowledge.
